title: Ban Chao’s Diplomatic Mission
synopsis: Ben Chao sets out on an important journey.

fullText.simplified:
班超出使

    刘秀是汉武帝的第九代孙子，他打败了“造反”的王莽，建立了东汉，成了又一个模范皇帝，汉朝又一次变得欣欣向荣。
    不过，正是因为刘秀脾气温和，不忍心让人民去打仗，匈奴反而屡次攻打他们，而刘秀从不还手。就这样，匈奴越来越肆无忌惮，到处出兵，让西域周围的小国也不得不听从他们。但是，刘秀一直以来运气可都不坏。记得他和王莽打仗的时候，王莽军队因为遇到狂风暴雨，损失惨重，最后输给了刘秀。这样的事情又一次发生了！
    有一天，匈奴忽然遭遇了一场天灾，死了一半人。有些匈奴人不想再过这种一直打来打去，不得安宁的日子了。于是一部分人出来投靠了汉朝，这群人就成了南匈奴，而不愿投靠的人就成了北匈奴。
    到了刘秀儿子汉明帝时期，北匈奴又倒霉地遇到了一次天灾，比起之前就更弱了。汉明帝觉得：这个时候再不把匈奴彻底消灭，还等什么时候呢？
    于是，汉明帝派军队攻打北匈奴，并大获全胜。这场胜利等于向西域各国宣告：强大的汉朝又回来啦！
    因为东汉之前一直没有攻打匈奴，所以大多数的西域国家都投靠了匈奴。这次攻打匈奴虽然胜利了，但汉明帝并不清楚那些西域国家还想不想归顺东汉。想要了解情况，游说西域各国，就需要派人出使西域。该派谁去呢？这时候，一个叫班超的年轻人出场了。
    班超出身在一个世世代代都是读书人的家庭。他爸爸、哥哥、姐姐等人，都是研究历史的，唯独班超对写史书不太感兴趣。特别是看到匈奴在边界这么欺负自己的国家，班超便说：“我一个大男人，应该有远大的抱负。国家有危险，我就该上战场去打仗！天天坐在桌子前拿支笔，算什么英雄好汉？”
    现在，机会来了。班超带着三十六个下属启程，替汉朝出使其他西域国家去了。他先去了他们觉得最友好、最好交涉的鄯善国，结果在鄯善国就差点丢了性命。
    起初，鄯善国国王特别热情地招待了他们。可还没过几天，国王的态度却突然冷淡下来了。班超觉得古怪，便猜测：是不是匈奴也派人来了鄯善国呢？
    为了证实自己的猜测，班超开口问一个鄯善国的下人：“匈奴的使者在哪里？什么时候来的？”
    下人吓了一跳，以为班超已经发现了他们的秘密，只好吞吞吐吐地承认，其实鄯善国国王背地里接待了一百多个人的匈奴使团，并已经和他们勾结起来了。现在那群人就在三十里外的地方，等着机会杀班超他们呢。
    班超一听，觉得大事不好，便果断地对手下的人说：“兄弟们，当务之急，我们要先下手为强。如果我们不敢冒险，现在不把那一百多个匈奴人统统消灭，过几天就轮到他们来消灭我们了。”
    于是班超和下属便趁着半夜，匈奴人睡觉的时候，偷偷袭击了匈奴使团，将一百多个人全部杀死，然后提着其中一个匈奴人的头去鄯善国国王面前。鄯善国国王立刻吓出一身冷汗，当场宣誓永远归顺汉朝。这件事情为班超出使西域开了一个好头。
    班超花了大半生的时间，终于帮汉朝同西域的五十多个小国建立了友好的关系。北匈奴在西域没了朋友便只能去中亚了，从此汉朝边界再也没有了匈奴。班超出使成了中国和西域国家建立友好关系的里程碑。
fullText.traditional:
班超出使

    劉秀是漢武帝的第九代孫子，他打敗了“造反”的王莽，建立了東漢，成了又一個模範皇帝，漢朝又一次變得欣欣向榮。
    不過，正是因為劉秀脾氣溫和，不忍心讓人民去打仗，匈奴反而屢次攻打他們，而劉秀從不還手。就這樣，匈奴越來越肆無忌憚，到處出兵，讓西域周圍的小國也不得不聽從他們。但是，劉秀一直以來運氣可都不壞。記得他和王莽打仗的時候，王莽軍隊因為遇到狂風暴雨，損失慘重，最後輸給了劉秀。這樣的事情又一次發生了！
    有一天，匈奴忽然遭遇了一場天災，死了一半人。有些匈奴人不想再過這種一直打來打去，不得安寧的日子了。於是一部分人出來投靠了漢朝，這群人就成了南匈奴，而不願投靠的人就成了北匈奴。
    到了劉秀兒子漢明帝時期，北匈奴又倒霉地遇到了一次天災，比起之前就更弱了。漢明帝覺得：這個時候再不把匈奴徹底消滅，還等什麼時候呢？
    於是，漢明帝派軍隊攻打北匈奴，並大獲全勝。這場勝利等於向西域各國宣告：強大的漢朝又回來啦！
    因為東漢之前一直沒有攻打匈奴，所以大多數的西域國家都投靠了匈奴。這次攻打匈奴雖然勝利了，但漢明帝並不清楚那些西域國家還想不想歸順東漢。想要了解情況，遊說西域各國，就需要派人出使西域。該派誰去呢？這時候，一個叫班超的年輕人出場了。
    班超出身在一個世世代代都是讀書人的家庭。他爸爸、哥哥、姐姐等人，都是研究歷史的，唯獨班超對寫史書不太感興趣。特別是看到匈奴在邊界這麼欺負自己的國家，班超便說：“我一個大男人，應該有遠大的抱負。國家有危險，我就該上戰場去打仗！天天坐在桌子前拿支筆，算什麼英雄好漢？”
    現在，機會來了。班超帶著三十六個下屬啟程，替漢朝出使其他西域國家去了。他先去了他們覺得最友好、最好交涉的鄯善國，結果在鄯善國就差點丟了性命。
    起初，鄯善國國王特別熱情地招待了他們。可還沒過幾天，國王的態度卻突然冷淡下來了。班超覺得古怪，便猜測：是不是匈奴也派人來了鄯善國呢？
    為了證實自己的猜測，班超開口問一個鄯善國的下人：“匈奴的使者在哪裡？什麼時候來的？”
    下人嚇了一跳，以為班超已經發現了他們的秘密，只好吞吞吐吐地承認，其實鄯善國國王背地裡接待了一百多個人的匈奴使團，並已經和他們勾結起來了。現在那群人就在三十里外的地方，等著機會殺班超他們呢。
    班超一聽，覺得大事不好，便果斷地對手下的人說：“兄弟們，當務之急，我們要先下手為強。如果我們不敢冒險，現在不把那一百多個匈奴人統統消滅，過幾天就輪到他們來消滅我們了。”
    於是班超和下屬便趁著半夜，匈奴人睡覺的時候，偷偷襲擊了匈奴使團，將一百多個人全部殺死，然後提著其中一個匈奴人的頭去鄯善國國王面前。鄯善國國王立刻嚇出一身冷汗，當場宣誓永遠歸順漢朝。這件事情為班超出使西域開了一個好頭。
    班超花了大半生的時間，終於幫漢朝同西域的五十多個小國建立了友好的關係。北匈奴在西域沒了朋友便只能去中亞了，從此漢朝邊界再也沒有了匈奴。班超出使成了中國和西域國家建立友好關係的里程碑。

sentences.traditional: 特別是看到匈奴在邊界這麼欺負自己的國家，班超便說：
sentences.pinyin: tè bié shì kàn dào xiōng nú zài biān jiè zhè me qī fu zì jǐ de guó jiā bān chāo biàn shuō
sentences.english: His father, older brother, and older sister all studied history. Only Ban Chao was not very interested in writing history books.

sentences.simplified: “我一个大男人，应该有远大的抱负。国家有危险，我就该上战场去打仗！
sentences.traditional: “我一個大男人，應該有遠大的抱負。國家有危險，我就該上戰場去打仗！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yí ge dà nán rén yīng gāi yǒu yuǎn dà de bào fù guó jiā yǒu wēi xiǎn wǒ jiù gāi shang zhàn chǎng qù dǎ zhàng
sentences.english: In particular, when he saw the Xiongnu taking advantage of his country at the border, Ban Chao said, ..

sentences.simplified: 天天坐在桌子前拿支笔，算什么英雄好汉？”
sentences.traditional: 天天坐在桌子前拿支筆，算什麼英雄好漢？”
sentences.pinyin: tiān tiān zuò zài zhuō zi qián ná zhī bǐ suàn shén me yīng xióng hǎo hàn
sentences.english: .. “As a great man, I should have great ambitions. If the country is in danger, I should go to war and fight!
Sitting at a desk with a pen every day, what kind of hero is that?”

sentences.simplified: 现在，机会来了。
sentences.traditional: 現在，機會來了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài jī huì lái le

sentences.simplified: 班超带着三十六个下属启程，
sentences.traditional: 班超帶著三十六個下屬啟程，
sentences.pinyin: bān chāo dài zhe sān shí liù ge xià shǔ qǐ chéng
sentences.english: Now was the opportunity.

sentences.simplified: 替汉朝出使其他西域国家去了。
sentences.traditional: 替漢朝出使其他西域國家去了。
sentences.pinyin: tì hàn cháo chū shǐ qí tā xī yù guó jiā qù le
sentences.english: Ban Chao set out on a journey with 36 subordinates, ..

sentences.simplified: 他先去了他们觉得最友好、最好交涉的鄯善国，
sentences.traditional: 他先去了他們覺得最友好、最好交涉的鄯善國，
sentences.pinyin: tā xiān qù le tā men jué de zuì yǒu hǎo zuì hǎo jiāo shè de shàn shàn guó
sentences.english: .. and went on a diplomatic mission to countries in the Western Regions for the Han Dynasty.

sentences.simplified: 结果在鄯善国就差点丢了性命。
sentences.traditional: 結果在鄯善國就差點丟了性命。
sentences.pinyin: jié guǒ zài shàn shàn guó jiù chà diǎn diū le xìng mìng
sentences.english: He first went to Shanshan, the country they felt was the most friendly and best to deal with.
As a result, he almost lost his life in Shanshan.

sentences.simplified: 起初，鄯善国国王特别热情地招待了他们。
sentences.traditional: 起初，鄯善國國王特別熱情地招待了他們。
sentences.pinyin: qǐ chū shàn shàn guó guó wáng tè bié rè qíng de zhāo dài le tā men

sentences.simplified: 可还没过几天，国王的态度却突然冷淡下来了。
sentences.traditional: 可還沒過幾天，國王的態度卻突然冷淡下來了。
sentences.pinyin: kě hái méi guò jǐ tiān guó wáng de tài du què tū rán lěng dàn xià lai le
sentences.english: At first, the king of Shanshan gave them a very warm reception.

sentences.simplified: 班超觉得古怪，便猜测：是不是匈奴也派人来了鄯善国呢？
sentences.traditional: 班超覺得古怪，便猜測：是不是匈奴也派人來了鄯善國呢？
sentences.pinyin: bān chāo jué de gǔ guài biàn cāi cè shì bú shì xiōng nú yě pài rén lái le shàn shàn guó ne
sentences.english: But a few days later, the king’s attitude suddenly became cold.
Ban Chao thought it was odd and speculated: Did the Xiongnu also send people to Shanshan?

sentences.simplified: 为了证实自己的猜测，班超开口问一个鄯善国的下人：
sentences.traditional: 為了證實自己的猜測，班超開口問一個鄯善國的下人：
sentences.pinyin: wèi le zhèng shí zì jǐ de cāi cè bān chāo kāi kǒu wèn yí ge shàn shàn guó de xià rén

sentences.simplified: “匈奴的使者在哪里？什么时候来的？”
sentences.traditional: “匈奴的使者在哪裡？什麼時候來的？”
sentences.pinyin: xiōng nú de shǐ zhě zài nǎ lǐ shén me shí hou lái de
sentences.english: In order to confirm his suspicions, Ban Chao asked a Shanshan subordinate, ..
.. “Where is the Xiongnu’s emissary? When did he come?”

sentences.simplified: 下人吓了一跳，以为班超已经发现了他们的秘密，
sentences.traditional: 下人嚇了一跳，以為班超已經發現了他們的秘密，
sentences.pinyin: xià rén xià le yí tiào yǐ wéi bān chāo yǐ jīng fā xiàn le tā men de mì mì

sentences.simplified: 只好吞吞吐吐地承认，
sentences.traditional: 只好吞吞吐吐地承認，
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ hǎo tūn tūn tǔ tǔ de chéng rèn
sentences.english: The subordinate was startled and thought Ban Chao had discovered their secret.

sentences.simplified: 其实鄯善国国王背地里接待了一百多个人的匈奴使团，并已经和他们勾结起来了。
sentences.traditional: 其實鄯善國國王背地裡接待了一百多個人的匈奴使團，並已經和他們勾結起來了。
sentences.pinyin: qí shí shàn shàn guó guó wáng bèi dì lǐ jiē dài le yì bǎi duō ge rén de xiōng nú shǐ tuán bìng yǐ jīng hé tā men gōu jié qǐ lái le
sentences.english: So he was forced to admit, hesitantly, ..

sentences.simplified: 现在那群人就在三十里外的地方，等着机会杀班超他们呢。
sentences.traditional: 現在那群人就在三十里外的地方，等著機會殺班超他們呢。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài nà qún rén jiù zài sān shí lǐ wài de dì fang děng zhe jī huì shā bān chāo tā men ne
sentences.english: .. that in fact, the king of Shanshan had received a Xiongnu mission of more than 100 men behind their backs and had colluded with them.
Now that group was 30 li away, waiting for a chance to kill Ban Chao and the others.

sentences.simplified: 班超一听，觉得大事不好，
sentences.traditional: 班超一聽，覺得大事不好，
sentences.pinyin: bān chāo yì tīng jué de dà shì bù hǎo

sentences.simplified: 便果断地对手下的人说：“兄弟们，当务之急，我们要先下手为强。
sentences.traditional: 便果斷地對手下的人說：“兄弟們，當務之急，我們要先下手為強。
sentences.pinyin: biàn guǒ duàn de duì shǒu xià de rén shuō xiōng dì men dāng wù zhī jí wǒ men yào xiān xià shǒu wéi qiáng
sentences.english: When Ban Chao heard this, he thought that the situation was very bad.

sentences.simplified: 如果我们不敢冒险，现在不把那一百多个匈奴人统统消灭，过几天就轮到他们来消灭我们了。”
sentences.traditional: 如果我們不敢冒險，現在不把那一百多個匈奴人統統消滅，過幾天就輪到他們來消滅我們了。”
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ wǒ men bù gǎn mào xiǎn xiàn zài bù bǎ nà yì bǎi duō ge xiōng nú rén tǒng tǒng xiāo miè guò jǐ tiān jiù lún dào tā men lái xiāo miè wǒ men le
sentences.english: So he said firmly to his men, “Brothers, it is imperative that we strike first to gain the upper hand.
If we don’t dare to take the risk and destroy all those more than 100 Xiongnu now, in a few days it will be their turn to destroy us.”

sentences.simplified: 于是班超和下属便趁着半夜，匈奴人睡觉的时候，
sentences.traditional: 於是班超和下屬便趁著半夜，匈奴人睡覺的時候，
sentences.pinyin: yú shì bān chāo hé xià shǔ biàn chèn zhe bàn yè xiōng nú rén shuì jiào de shí hou

sentences.simplified: 偷偷袭击了匈奴使团，将一百多个人全部杀死，
sentences.traditional: 偷偷襲擊了匈奴使團，將一百多個人全部殺死，
sentences.pinyin: tōu tōu xí jī le xiōng nú shǐ tuán jiāng yì bǎi duō ge rén quán bù shā sǐ
sentences.english: So Ban Chao and his subordinates waited until night when the Xiongnu were sleeping, ..

sentences.simplified: 然后提着其中一个匈奴人的头去鄯善国国王面前。
sentences.traditional: 然後提著其中一個匈奴人的頭去鄯善國國王面前。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu tí zhe qí zhōng yí ge xiōng nú rén de tóu qù shàn shàn guó guó wáng miàn qián
sentences.english: .. then secretly attacked their mission and killed all of the more than 100 men.

sentences.simplified: 鄯善国国王立刻吓出一身冷汗，
sentences.traditional: 鄯善國國王立刻嚇出一身冷汗，
sentences.pinyin: shàn shàn guó guó wáng lì kè xià chū yì shēn lěng hàn
sentences.english: Then they carried the head of one of the Xiongnu to the king of Shanshan.

sentences.simplified: 当场宣誓永远归顺汉朝。
sentences.traditional: 當場宣誓永遠歸順漢朝。
sentences.pinyin: dāng chǎng xuān shì yǒng yuǎn guī shùn hàn cháo
sentences.english: The king of Shanshan immediately broke out in a cold sweat.

sentences.simplified: 这件事情为班超出使西域开了一个好头。
sentences.traditional: 這件事情為班超出使西域開了一個好頭。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì qing wèi bān chāo chū shǐ xī yù kāi le yí ge hǎo tóu
sentences.english: On the spot, he swore to submit and pledge allegiance to the Han Dynasty forever.
This incident was a good start for Ban Chao’s diplomatic mission to the Western Regions.

sentences.simplified: 班超花了大半生的时间，
sentences.traditional: 班超花了大半生的時間，
sentences.pinyin: bān chāo huā le dà bàn shēng de shí jiān

sentences.simplified: 终于帮汉朝同西域的五十多个小国建立了友好的关系。
sentences.traditional: 終於幫漢朝同西域的五十多個小國建立了友好的關係。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng yú bāng hàn cháo tóng xī yù de wǔ shí duō ge xiǎo guó jiàn lì le yǒu hǎo de guān xi
sentences.english: It took Ban Chao most of his life, ..

sentences.simplified: 北匈奴在西域没了朋友便只能去中亚了，
sentences.traditional: 北匈奴在西域沒了朋友便只能去中亞了，
sentences.pinyin: běi xiōng nú zài xī yù méi le péng you biàn zhǐ néng qù zhōng yà le
sentences.english: .. to help the Han Dynasty establish friendly relations with more than 50 small countries in the Western Regions.

sentences.simplified: 从此汉朝边界再也没有了匈奴。
sentences.traditional: 從此漢朝邊界再也沒有了匈奴。
sentences.pinyin: cóng cǐ hàn cháo biān jiè zài yě méi yǒu le xiōng nú
sentences.english: The Northern Xiongnu had no friends in the Western Regions and were forced to go to Central Asia.

sentences.simplified: 班超出使成了中国和西域国家建立友好关系的里程碑。
sentences.traditional: 班超出使成了中國和西域國家建立友好關係的里程碑。
sentences.pinyin: bān chāo chū shǐ chéng le zhōng guó hé xī yù guó jiā jiàn lì yǒu hǎo guān xi de lǐ chéng bēi
sentences.english: From then on, there were no more Xiongnu on the borders of the Han Dynasty.

sentence_translations: Ban Chao’s Diplomatic Mission
Liu Xiu was the ninth-generation grandson of Emperor Wu of Han.
He defeated the “rebellious” Wang Mang and established the Eastern Han Dynasty, becoming another model emperor.
The Han Dynasty flourished once again.
However, precisely because Liu Xiu was mild-tempered and could not bear to let the people go to war, ..
.. the Xiongnu instead attacked them repeatedly, while Liu Xiu never fought back.
In this way, the Xiongnu became more and more unbridled, sending troops everywhere, ..
.. so that the small countries around the Western Regions also had to obey them.
However, Liu Xiu always had pretty good luck.
Remember when he fought with Wang Mang, ..
.. Wang Mang’s troops suffered heavy losses due to violent storms and ultimately lost to Liu Xiu.
Something like that happened again!
One day, the Xiongnu were suddenly hit by a natural disaster, and half of them died.
Some of the Xiongnu didn’t want to live this kind of life anymore, constantly fighting and never having any peace.
So some of them came out and defected to the Han Dynasty. This group became the Southern Xiongnu.
Meanwhile, those who were not willing to defect became the Northern Xiongnu.
During the time of Liu Xiu’s son, Emperor Ming of Han, ..
.. the Northern Xiongnu were unlucky enough to encounter yet another natural disaster and were even weaker than before.
Emperor Ming thought: If we don’t destroy the Xiongnu completely this time, then what are we waiting for?
So, Emperor Ming sent his troops to attack the Northern Xiongnu and won a great victory.
This victory was tantamount to announcing to every country in the Western Regions that the mighty Han Dynasty was back!
Because the Eastern Han Dynasty had not attacked the Xiongnu before, ..
.. most of the countries in the Western Regions had thrown their lot in with the Xiongnu.
Although the attack on the Xiongnu was victorious, ..
.. Emperor Ming was not sure if those countries in the Western Regions still wanted to submit to the Eastern Han.
To understand the situation and lobby in the countries in the Western Regions, ..
.. he needed to send someone on a diplomatic mission to the Western Regions.
Who should he send? At this time, a young man named Ban Chao appeared.
Ban Chao came from a family that had been scholars for many generations.
His father, older brother, and older sister all studied history. Only Ban Chao was not very interested in writing history books.
In particular, when he saw the Xiongnu taking advantage of his country at the border, Ban Chao said, ..
.. “As a great man, I should have great ambitions. If the country is in danger, I should go to war and fight!
Sitting at a desk with a pen every day, what kind of hero is that?”
Now was the opportunity.
Ban Chao set out on a journey with 36 subordinates, ..
.. and went on a diplomatic mission to countries in the Western Regions for the Han Dynasty.
He first went to Shanshan, the country they felt was the most friendly and best to deal with.
As a result, he almost lost his life in Shanshan.
At first, the king of Shanshan gave them a very warm reception.
But a few days later, the king’s attitude suddenly became cold.
Ban Chao thought it was odd and speculated: Did the Xiongnu also send people to Shanshan?
In order to confirm his suspicions, Ban Chao asked a Shanshan subordinate, ..
.. “Where is the Xiongnu’s emissary? When did he come?”
The subordinate was startled and thought Ban Chao had discovered their secret.
So he was forced to admit, hesitantly, ..
.. that in fact, the king of Shanshan had received a Xiongnu mission of more than 100 men behind their backs and had colluded with them.
Now that group was 30 li away, waiting for a chance to kill Ban Chao and the others.
When Ban Chao heard this, he thought that the situation was very bad.
So he said firmly to his men, “Brothers, it is imperative that we strike first to gain the upper hand.
If we don’t dare to take the risk and destroy all those more than 100 Xiongnu now, in a few days it will be their turn to destroy us.”
So Ban Chao and his subordinates waited until night when the Xiongnu were sleeping, ..
.. then secretly attacked their mission and killed all of the more than 100 men.
Then they carried the head of one of the Xiongnu to the king of Shanshan.
The king of Shanshan immediately broke out in a cold sweat.
On the spot, he swore to submit and pledge allegiance to the Han Dynasty forever.
This incident was a good start for Ban Chao’s diplomatic mission to the Western Regions.
It took Ban Chao most of his life, ..
.. to help the Han Dynasty establish friendly relations with more than 50 small countries in the Western Regions.
The Northern Xiongnu had no friends in the Western Regions and were forced to go to Central Asia.
From then on, there were no more Xiongnu on the borders of the Han Dynasty.
Ban Chao’s diplomatic mission was a milestone in forming friendly relations between China and the countries in the Western Regions.
